> All listed items are advertised offers only, not received income. Written scope, acceptance checks and funded payment terms are agreed before work starts.

- [Five fixed-scope offers](https://sidsri14.github.io/implementation-packages.html): direct Contra service pages and no-signup Contra payment links.

- [No-signup request form](https://sidsri14.github.io/request-work.html): opens an email in the buyer's own mail client; no account, fee, card, wallet or third-party submission.
- [Free browser-only checkout link checker](https://sidsri14.github.io/checkout-audit.html): private, client-side tool that finds product/price mismatches between static cards and their checkout links; no upload, account, form endpoint, card or wallet.
- [Free browser-only basis-point fee calculator](https://sidsri14.github.io/fee-math-calculator.html): deterministic integer-cent, half-up fee and net calculation; no upload, account, form endpoint, card or wallet.
- [Home and proof index](https://sidsri14.github.io/): projects, articles and verification page.
